column1: # The project's config read through its overrides file: a key the overrides file
# carries replaces the committed value WHOLE, a key it omits falls through, and an
# unreadable file in the pair reads as an unreadable config does. Read by BOTH
# ports (merge-pr's read_config_scalar / Get-ConfigScalar). Fixtures are under
